crates-io/sha2

sha2

Pure Rust implementation of the SHA-2 hash function family including SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512.

README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

RustCrypto: SHA-2

crate Docs Apache2/MIT licensed Rust Version Project Chat Build Status

Pure Rust implementation of the SHA-2 hash function family including SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512.

Documentation

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RustCrypto/meta/master/img/hashes/sha2.png" width="480px">

Minimum Supported Rust Version

Rust 1.41 or higher.

Minimum supported Rust version can be changed in the future, but it will be done with a minor version bump.

SemVer Policy

  • All on-by-default features of this library are covered by SemVer
  • MSRV is considered exempt from SemVer as noted above

Dependencies

Version requirements

Version requirements are declarations, not resolved versions. Target conditions apply to each declaration individually.

DependencyRequirement & featuresActivation
crates-io/cfg-ifAlias: cfg-if^1.0Default features: enabledRequests: Required
crates-io/cpufeaturesAlias: cpufeatures^0.2Default features: enabledRequests: Required · when cfg(any(target_arch = "aarch64", target_arch = "x86_64", target_arch = "x86"))
crates-io/digestAlias: digest^0.10.7Default features: enabledRequests: Required
crates-io/sha2-asmAlias: sha2-asm^0.6.1Default features: enabledRequests: Optional · not enabled by defaults · when cfg(any(target_arch = "aarch64", target_arch = "x86_64", target_arch = "x86"))

CHANGELOG.md · Author-provided

Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

0.10.9 (2025-04-30)

Added
  • force-soft-compact crate feature to enable compact software backend (backport of #686) #687

0.10.8 (2023-09-26)

Added
  • asm!-based backend for LoongArch64 targets gated behind loongarch64_asm feature #507

0.10.7 (2023-06-15)

Added
  • AArch64 Neon-based backend (#490)

0.10.6 (2022-09-16)

Added
  • Feature-gated OID support (#405)

0.10.5 (2022-09-02)

Fixed
  • MSRV issue which was not resolved by v0.10.4 (#401)

0.10.4 (2022-09-02)

Fixed
  • MSRV issue caused by publishing v0.10.3 using a buggy Nightly toolchain (#399)

0.10.3 (2022-08-30)

Changed
  • Ignore asm feature on unsupported targets (#388)

0.10.2 (2022-02-17)

Fixed
  • Minimal versions build (#363)

0.10.1 (2022-01-06)

Fixed
  • Bug in the AVX2 backend (#345)

0.10.0 (2021-12-07) [YANKED]

Changed
  • Update to digest v0.10 (#217)
  • Rename Sha512Trunc224 and Sha512Trunc256 to Sha512_224 and Sha512_256 respectively. (#217)

0.9.9 (2022-01-06)

Fixed
  • Backport #345 bug fix for the AVX2 backend (#346)

0.9.8 (2021-09-09) [YANKED]

Fixed
  • Bug in the AVX2 backend (#314)

0.9.7 (2021-09-08) [YANKED]

Added
  • x86 intrinsics support for SHA-512 (#312)

0.9.6 (2021-08-27)

Changed
  • Bump cpufeatures dependency to 0.2 (#306)

0.9.5 (2021-05-11)

Changed
  • Use cpufeatures to detect intrinsics support on aarch64 targets (#267)

0.9.4 (2021-05-05)

Added
  • Hardware accelerated SHA-256 for Apple M1 CPUs with asm feature (#262)
Changed
  • Bump sha2-asm to v0.6.1 release (#262)
  • Switch from cpuid-bool to cpufeatures (#263)

0.9.3 (2021-01-30)

Changed
  • Use the SHA-NI extension backend with enabled asm feature. (#224)

0.9.2 (2020-11-04)

Added
  • force-soft feature to enforce use of software implementation. (#203)
Changed
  • cfg-if dependency updated to v1.0. (#197)

0.9.1 (2020-06-24)

Added
  • x86 hardware acceleration of SHA-256 via SHA extension instrinsics. (#167)

0.9.0 (2020-06-09)

Changed
  • Update to digest v0.9 release; MSRV 1.41+ (#155)
  • Use new *Dirty traits from the digest crate (#153)
  • Bump block-buffer to v0.8 release (#151)
  • Rename *result* to finalize (#148)
  • Upgrade to Rust 2018 edition (#133)

0.8.2 (2020-05-23)

Added
  • Expose compression function under the compress feature flag (#108)
Changed
  • Use libc crate for aarch64 consts (#109)
  • Minor code cleanups (#94)

0.8.1 (2020-01-05)

[project]
name = "crates-io/sha2"
version = "0.10.9"

[project.features]
asm = ["sha2-asm"]
asm-aarch64 = ["asm"]
compress = []
default = ["std"]
force-soft = []
force-soft-compact = []
loongarch64_asm = []
oid = ["digest/oid"]
sha2-asm = ["dep:sha2-asm"]
std = ["digest/std"]

[rust]
name = "sha2"
type = "lib"
edition = "2018"

[dependencies]
cfg-if = { loaf = "crates-io/cfg-if", version = "^1.0" }
